source.trade_day_boundary: 17:00 previous calendar day through 16:59 current calendar day
source.intraday_sampling: 5-minute last-close bars derived only from cached 1-minute observations

RSV_TTSM_S2_1D.rule: TTSM-S2 adapted as a direction-only reject-option specialist: both semivariances high => NO_SIGNAL; both low => keep 20-origin momentum sign; RSminus high only => reverse UP momentum to DOWN and abstain on DOWN momentum; RSplus high only => reverse DOWN momentum to UP and abstain on UP momentum.

MODERATE_DOWNSHOCK_REVERSAL_1D.formation_basis: pre-2025 Gold Control formation-only diagnostic plus short-horizon reversal literature
MODERATE_DOWNSHOCK_REVERSAL_1D.rule: If current exact-origin log return is negative and its absolute magnitude lies strictly above the trailing median and at or below the trailing 75th percentile, predict UP; otherwise NO_SIGNAL.

EUROPE_SESSION_CONTINUATION_1D.rule: Predict the next exact NY17 direction equal to the sign of the same-day Europe-session return when both endpoint bars exist; zero return => NO_SIGNAL.
